profile.headline: Senior . NET Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack Software Engineer with 6 years of experience building scalable web applications using modern UI frameworks like React and Angular. Adept at designing intuitive user experiences and implementing robust backend services with .NET and Node.js. Experienced with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), CI/CD, and system architecture, with a passion for crafting performant and seamless web applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Web-based document translation platform to streamline multilingual communication for city services.

• Independently developed a React UI, enhancing accessibility, and user experience for document translation.
• Built .NET minimal APIs with Entity Framework Core and SQL Server, streamlining data processing.
• Integrated Microsoft AI Translator, DeepL, and Google Translate, enabling translations in 200+ languages.
• Implemented authentication via Microsoft Entra Id for secure role-based access.
• Designed an audit logging system to track user activity, translation metrics, and departmental usage.
• Created an interactive dashboard with charts to visualize costs, usage trends, and language distribution.
• Utilized Azure Blob Storage and Google Cloud Storage for secure document processing and storage.
• Technologies used: React.js, TypeScript, .NET Core, C#, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server,  Microsoft Entra Id, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage.
positions.insights: Full-Stack Development, Software Design and +14 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: A SaaS web application for energy utilities to analyze and manage power grid impact from EV charging.

• Built and optimized AngularJS UI, improving data visualization and user interaction.
• Developed interactive analytics dashboards with granular EV charging and grid impact metrics.
• Designed and developed .NET Core backend APIs using Domain Driven Design and Repositories, enabling
efficient data processing and cohesive business logic.
• Integrated Kafka for real-time data streaming, ensuring accurate, low-latency updates, and async processes.
• Leveraged Azure services for hosting, deployment, and scalability, ensuring system reliability.
• Technologies used: Angular.js, TypeScript, .NET Core, C#, SQL Server, Entity Framework, Kafka, Azure, RxJS, MSTest, MediatR, DDD

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: A SaaS veterinary software and automation platform.

• Designed and enhanced React components for a seamless veterinary clinic and pet owner experience.
• Enhanced frontend state using React hooks and context, boosting performance and reducing re-renders.
• Leveraged GraphQL queries and mutations to streamline data fetching and improve API efficiency.
• Collaborated on microservices-based systems, integrating SQS for real-time messaging and event handling.
• Refactored an asynchronous data pipeline, significantly improving scalability and fault tolerance.
• Developed detailed logging and monitoring mechanisms to capture granular information about pipeline
operations, health, and operations.
• Utilized Prisma and PostgreSQL to streamline database interactions and ensure data integrity.
• Technologies used: React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, Prisma, PostgreSQL, DynamoDb, Firebase, AWS SQS, AWS S3, Kubernetes, Docker, Stripe, Sendgrid, New Relic, Elasticsearch, Jest.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Comprehensive SaaS student education web application.

• Built and optimized Blazor framework UI, ensuring a responsive and intuitive experience for educators.
• Utilized AWS Polly to enable text-to-speech capabilities for enhanced accessibility.
• Designed and developed .NET Core backend services and APIs, enabling seamless data integration.
• Implemented PDF generation features, enabling customizable printable assignments.
• Orchestrated assignment coordination functionalities, allowing seamless management of assignments.
• Led major refactoring efforts to improve the extensibility, maintainability, and performance of a Knockout.js-based interactive document editor.
• Integrated Azure services to leverage cloud-based functionalities such as storage, authentication, and scalability, enhancing the overall reliability and performance of the tools.
• Technologies used: ASP.NET, .NET Framework, .NET Core, C#, Blazor, Knockout.js, JQuery, TypeScript, SQL Server, Azure, Blob Storage, Azure Active Directory, AWS Poly, xUnit.
